text:
ana (PM): quick check — we have a hard launch target in 3 weeks. proposal: move two non-blocking org-level features (multi-tenant analytics & advanced quotas UI) from MVP -> v1, keep core inference, auth, billing for MVP. this buys ~2 sprints of scope.
sarah (CS): +1 from customer signals. top three pilot customers said analytics can be post-launch if we ship stability and perf.
mike (Eng): what are the exact deps? analytics touches schema migrations + telemetry pipeline. that migration is low-risk but needs ops time. quotas UI is mostly frontend + backend flagging.
nana (ana): @mike good call, i mean @mike — I'll list deps. main ask: do we still meet launch criteria (latency p95, error budget, key flows) if we trim?
ravi (SRE): trimming analytics helps. migrations are the main risk window; if we de-scope analytics we avoid a DB migration in the critical path. p95 target still realistic. need dedicated soak for 48h after canary.
mike (Eng): agree on soak. concern: quotas UI shares the same rate-limit config path as billing; if we postpone quotas UI we must keep the quotas API stable for customers. will need a tiny API shim.
jordan (Design): UX impact: customers expecting analytics in pilot might be surprised. can we ship a clear in-product banner + rollout email?
sarah (CS): i'll draft messaging and a support playbook.
nana (ana): action items: 1) mike to spec minimal API shim for quotas and confirm dev estimate (due EOD today). 2) ravi to schedule canary + 48h soak window in next deploy (due tomorrow). 3) sarah to prep customer messaging + support doc (due Friday). 4) jordan to create the banner copy.
mike (Eng): estimate: shim + tests = 3 engineer-days, no infra changes. putting as PR after tomorrow's sprint planning.
ravi (SRE): canary window scheduled for 1738460400-1738461320 (UTC). will tag deploy-bot for telemetry hooks.
deploy-bot: noted — will create canary release and attach tracing. :robot_face:
sarah (CS): messaging draft: "We're focusing our first launch on core reliability and performance. Advanced analytics will follow in the v1 update. If you'd like early access, reply to this thread."
nana (PM): sounds good. decision: approve scope trim -> move analytics + quotas UI to v1, keep quotas API shim for MVP. trade-offs logged in the roadmap doc.
mike (Eng): defending note: if any hidden perf regressions show up during soak we should be prepared to rollback by feature-flagging inference changes. adding a rollback checklist to the PR.
ravi (SRE): +1 for rollback checklist. I'll add runbook steps and a metric dashboard (p95, error-rate, token-cost anomaly).
jordan (Design): will push banner + quick modal by tomorrow noon.
sarah (CS): support playbook posted at https://wiki.internal/redwood/launch-support — tagging folks.
nana (PM): final: owner assignments done. I'll update the milestone tracker and cut list. meeting if any blocker crops up. :thumbsup:
